categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Changes BIP-352 input public key extraction logic in src/common/bip352.cpp, part of the node's shared cryptographic libraries.
categories.rationale: Fixes a correctness bug in BIP-352 public key extraction where non-P2WPKH P2SH inputs could mistakenly have unintended pubkeys summed into A_sum, corrupting derived shared secrets. The commit notes that failing to check that the P2SH redeem script matches the UTXO script hash treats non-P2WPKH inputs with dummy redeem scripts as eligible BIP-352 inputs; reviewers note that valid transactions are unaffected and characterize it as an important robustness fix.
